summary: AI video agent that turns ideas into videos through natural conversation, covering visuals, audio, captions and editing, with official smart model selection.

pricing.details: Pro 27 €/month — 3,000 base credits (limited-time bonus 1,800, total 4,800 while the bonus lasts), approx. 2–5 min video. Elite 54 €/month — 7,200 base credits (limited-time bonus 2,800, total 10,000), approx. 5–11 min. Max 90 €/month — 14,000 base credits (limited-time bonus 4,000, total 18,000 credits/month), approx. 9–20 min. Regular allowances are the base credits; the extra credits are an official limited-time promo, not the regular allowance. No lasting Free plan was stated on the official pricing page.
